result.scope: Unnamed per-day candidate diagnostics. No tracked current/eddy register, runtime, release, state geometry or index modified.

method.closure: ContourPy SeparateCode CLOSEPOLY plus identical first/last coordinates; never snap or bridge.
method.missing_data: corner_mask=False; reject any missing grid-point interior and any domain-clipped contour.
method.orientation: Positive signed spherical area retains high-interior contours; low-interior loops excluded.
method.mean: Finite ocean gridpoints within longitude -99..-80 and latitude 17..31; arithmetic primary, cosine latitude weighting diagnostic alternative.
method.sensitivity: Independent 0.15/0.17/0.19 m contours for each of two means. IDs are local to each date/scenario, never a cross-scenario or temporal identity.
method.metric_scope: Enclosed spherical contour area, planar area-equivalent diameter, geographic bounding arcs and perimeter. Bounding arcs are not along-flow length, minimum width or principal axes.

previous_goal_turn_classification: progress: pinned original source header and coordinate audit
review_refinement: First successful-run map omitted open/rejected paths. Final run shows all 0.17 m paths as dashed context, explicit eligible closed-loop counts and local candidate labels. The complete daily numeric results are byte-equivalent as JSON objects between runs.
scientific_interpretation: Tests verify known spherical circle area/spans to stated tolerances, cancellation of constant daily offsets, explicit weighting/domain behavior, sensitivity direction, and rejection of open, low-interior and missing-interior loops. They do not validate physical eddy edges or named identity.
Published source-case dates are comparison context only. Some dates yield no eligible 0.17 m contour; 2008-07-01 yields two. Date-only or largest-loop joins would be unsupported.

On 2013-03-24 the arithmetic 0.19 m scenario closes a loop while 0.17 m remains connected. On 2013-03-31 a closed candidate appears at all six scenarios. Topology and event timing depend on threshold/product, not just a small change in dimension.
The 4000 km2 area screen defines review eligibility, not the absence of smaller eddies. Rejected/open context paths remain visible and are never closed synthetically.
No cross-scenario matching or temporal tracking performed; candidate IDs restart per date/scenario. Do not combine unmatched loop metrics into sensitivity ranges.
Dukhovskoy 2015 uses a different CCAR product and source-defined event dates. Numeric agreement was not used to tune the contour threshold; exact cross-product calibration has not been established.
